subject: The 2AM data pattern you're missing
preview_text: One filter in Predictify turns losing streaks into winning moves. See it now.
body_paragraphs: I was up at 2AM last Tuesday, staring at a racecard for a 4-horse field at Wolverhampton. The favorite looked obvious—but my AI flagged a 12/1 shot with a hidden edge: a 3-pound weight drop, a jockey with a 34% win rate on the surface, and a trainer hitting 22% in the past 14 days. That horse won by 2 lengths. The punchline? Every user has access to the same data, but 9 out of 10 never filter for that combo.

Here's the hack that transforms Predictify for you: go to any racecard and tap the 'Advanced Filters' button—it's hiding in the top-right corner. Most people just scroll the predictions, but the real power is in the 'Weight Advantage' and 'Jockey-Trainer Combo' sliders. Set 'Weight Advantage' to 3+ pounds and 'Jockey-Trainer Win Rate' to 20%+ for the last 30 days. Instantly, you'll see only the horses with a statistical edge that the crowd misses.

This isn't guesswork—it's the same logic sharp punters use to find value at Cheltenham or the Melbourne Cup. The AI already crunches thousands of variables, but this filter lets you laser-focus on the bets with the highest probability of an upset. Try it on the next racecard you open—I promise you'll spot things the form guide never shows you.

Open Predictify now and test this on today's racecards. Even one win from this filter pays for a month of Premium. P.S. The 'Confidence Score' column turns red when a horse has a 70%+ edge using these filters—watch for that color.
